name: input_modality
description: Within-subjects comparison of keyboard, push-to-talk dictation and hands-free (VAD) dictation for copying Greek academic sentences.
research_questions: RQ1: Do text-entry speed (WPM) and error rate differ between keyboard and speech input in Greek?
RQ2: Does speech input change perceived workload (raw NASA-TLX) compared with the keyboard?
RQ3: How do push-to-talk and voice-activity (hands-free) dictation compare in speed, errors and workload?
